guide.overview: [CONTENT NEEDED] Explain Part 3's focus on meaning, values, emotion, and balance.
guide.what_you_do: [CONTENT NEEDED] Describe the 10-day curriculum exploring values, relationships, and integration.
guide.what_you_produce: [CONTENT NEEDED] List deliverables: values workbook, integration reflections, alignment statement.
guide.save_resume_behavior: Your daily responses save automatically. You can work at your own pace across 10 days. Progress is preserved across sessions.
guide.privacy_statement: All responses are stored locally in your browser. No data is transmitted externally or used for purposes beyond your own reflection.
guide.reset_behavior: You can reset Part 3 and begin again. Resetting clears all responses. If you've exported your values workbook, it remains saved separately.
guide.product_boundaries: Part 3 is an educational curriculum exploring meaning and values. It is not therapy, counseling, or a substitute for mental health professional support.
guide.accessibility_statement: Part 3 supports High Contrast, Readable Font, Text Scale, and Reduced Motion. Optional browser dictation is available.

launcher.role_description: A 10-day journey to explore meaning, values, and what truly matters to you.
